headline: The gate-name honesty sweep found a class, not two instances: ten CI gates were reading as clean passes on a property their body never measured.

items.title: A safety gate ran two of the four protections it defines
items.insight: check-worker-rewriter-safety defined and self-tested four unsafe-op scanners but wired only two into the code that runs against the real Worker — the nonce Content-Type drop and the HEAD cache-poison guard were dead in production while green in self-test. All four now flow through one composed scan; a self-test fails if any registered scanner stops running live. Wiring the dormant HEAD scanner surfaced that its assertion had drifted from the Worker (the Worker strengthened its GET guard); the Worker was read before the gate was touched and confirmed safe on all four.

items.title: A CANON-008 compliance check that could never fail
items.insight: The IP/legal check passed on the mere presence of the string CANON-008, which the propagated canon index carries in every repo. It now requires a real license declaration in the rights artifact — a canon-id mention is not a license.

items.title: A launch gate that silently exempted every launched project
items.insight: Every SPARKED comparison used case-sensitive 'SPARKED' while the registry stores lowercase 'sparked', so no SPARKED-specific enforcement ever fired; and the live-URL check read liveUrl where the registry's canonical field is runtimeUrl. Both fixed; this repo now correctly reads 100% GO instead of a false pass.

items.title: Seven more gates fixed to measure the property they name
items.insight: news-engagement engaged-time now checks drift not just fabrication; build-step-resilience now catches unguarded gitignored reads across 82 build scripts; game-playability runs its sourceRepo check on clean pages; registry-freshness populated a dead urlDrift bucket (surfaced a real mindframe drift); hero-jsonld treats empty arrays as missing; journal-dates tests for a day number not a comma; portfolio-coherence dropped a sitemap leg it never read.
items.evidence: 7 gates, each locked with a both-directions self-test

followUps: Sweep the build-*.mjs --check gates as a class for the same defect (S323 covered check-*.mjs only).
Ark pattern-share to studio-ops: registry live-URL field is runtimeUrl not liveUrl; case-sensitive vaultStatus === 'SPARKED' disables SPARKED enforcement portfolio-wide.
blockers: real-provider-e2e-pending: one founder passkey ceremony (CANON-019 founder-reserved).
mindframe registry deployedUrl drift + franchise-architect portfolio drift are studio-ops-owned (CANON-018).
